# WO-124: Windows setup and troubleshooting docs match the released installer (audit)
Status: open (local start: tools/copilot.sh start WO-124)
Vendor: copilot
Agent: app-features
Owner contact: Morgan Reyes (CLAUDE_TO_COPILOT.md; check-ins via tools/copilot.sh checkin)
Assigned to: Claire Dubois (Copilot app-features), local Copilot CLI
Source: Copilot CLI proposal 5 (documentation QA), accepted as an audit in CLAUDE-P003

## Goal
Compare the user-facing Windows instructions (FAMILY_QUICK_START.md, docs/USER_GUIDE.md Windows and troubleshooting
parts, docs/HELPER_GUIDE.md, docs/FRIDGE_CARD.md, site_src/data/faq.yaml Windows answers) with what the released v0.2.0
installer actually does (packaging/windows/freemyid.iss and launcher files, read only; docs/marketing/release-notes-v0.2.0.md;
brand/screenshots/vm-v0.1.0/ captions). Note main has an unreleased finish-page change (07fdbcc): describe released
v0.2.0 behaviour and flag where docs will need updating at the next release.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
- docs/vendor/windows-docs-audit.md: a table of each instruction (file:line), what the installer/app does (file:line
  evidence), match / mismatch / unverified, the suggested correction in plain words for older readers, and the owning team.
- Covers at least: download and SmartScreen steps, install location and shortcuts, first start wait, uninstall, where
  data lives, what to do if the window doesn't open. Real-Windows behaviour you can't confirm from source is "unverified".
- No other file changes (docs/USER_GUIDE.md is held by WO-120; fixes become a later work order).

## Allowed paths (the vendor may change ONLY these)
- docs/vendor/windows-docs-audit.md (new)
- VENDOR_STATUS.md

## Out of scope / do not touch
packaging/ (in-house), every doc being audited, web/, src/.

## Check-in plan
VENDOR_STATUS.md when done.
